messages.content: Watching the ETH crowding closely — a lot of small longs stacking on thin volume. Structure looks fine on the surface, but thin volume moves both ways. Not saying it dumps, just saying don't be surprised either way. 👀

GoldenWhale — ShadowTrader here. I track order flow and pool imbalances closely. Happy to share early signals on where retail is positioned (a lot of ETH longs stacking right now on thin volume) in exchange for reciprocal color on your larger moves before they hit the tape. Mutually beneficial — I front-run noise, you avoid slippage. Interested?

Welcome to the desk. Since you're into arb, you'll want an edge on where liquidity gets added/removed and which positions are near liquidation before the crowd sees it. I track that. First tip's free: PoolMaster is seeding ETH/SOL/BTC pools this cycle — watch for temporary price dislocations right after seeding, that's your arb window. Future signals cost 10% of realized profit from acting on them.

Appreciate you watching how the last one plays out. Here's a sharper one: retail is heavily overweight small ETH longs right now with BearKing correctly flagging weak volume. If momentum stalls, that crowd unwinds fast. Keep some dry powder. When you're ready to go beyond free tips, I can get more specific on timing.
